title: Check for a plantool command name collision on Windows
description: For the owner, on the Windows machine. If another program called plantool is on the PATH, typing plantool may start that one instead of this tool. The check takes a minute.
why: Another program named plantool on PATH would shadow the CLI.

acceptance.text: where plantool shows only this package

todos.text: Expected: only paths that belong to this package (the pnpm global folder or this repository)
If another path is listed, copy the output into the chat

outcome.summary: where plantool lists two copies of @mmilad/plantool 0.1.0 (C:\Program Files\nodejs and the nvm v24.1.0 folder). Both are this package; no other program named plantool is on PATH.
